== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Hunger spears are specialized weapons crafted from pure [[white hunger madra]]. These devices feature etched [[scripts]] designed to channel the energy of the [[madra]] directly into an attacker. While versions originally intended for [[Gold-level]] soldiers exist within labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth, they can be upgraded or recreated for more advanced combatants. Some iterations of these weapons are reinforced with additional frames, and certain models possess unique internal binding{{!}}bindings, such as the [[Blighted Sky]], which can release a wide array of destructive orange spikes. These weapons are capable of delivering immense power, sometimes rivaling the strength of an [[Archlord]]'s strike.}}
